body:
Hi again,

This is the cleaned version of a long chat. The user first wrote from {{Email}} and signed the note as {{Name}}. A later reply changed tone, added thanks, and asked whether the phone desk could use {{custom:phone}} instead of the number stored in the old sandbox. The text also mentions amounts like 42.00 and 100.25, plus a fake form value 111-11-1111 that should remain plain text.

The payment paragraph says that the synthetic account can receive a reversal through {{custom:iban}}. The shipping paragraph says the region should be checked against {{custom:postal_code}}. The diagnostics paragraph says the form submission came through {{custom:ip_address}}. None of this is written in a neat order because real conversations drift from topic to topic, repeat details, and bury the important facts between ordinary sentences.

Thanks,
Case desk
notes: Page-tier EN chat transcript with filler and benign numeric distractors.
